package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"

	a "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/decl/components/a"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/a"
	_ "example.com/blog/orbit_gen/impl/components/b"
	"github.com/bertrandkhe/orbit"
)

func main() {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := a.Render(&orbit.Ctx{}, orbit.NewWriter(&buf), a.Props{Depth: 1}, orbit.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(buf.String())
}
